decision: Diagnostic failure for performance interpretation: measured-phase Triton JIT at RABIT C=16 and C=32 in all three trials. Measured-phase JIT is not accepted; no throughput / latency value of this run is interpreted, published or pooled with any other attempt; uncontaminated points are NOT salvaged.
archival_note: Every other file in this directory is the byte-exact output of the run (moved unchanged from results/mlsys2027/concurrency_scaling/L2048/conditioned/; SHA-256 verified before and after the move). Paths recorded inside manifest.json refer to the original location. This file is the only one added after the run.
protocol: point-matched C-request compile-conditioning (superseded by full shadow-workload conditioning)

execution_facts.target_overlapping_inflight_concurrency: reached at all 36 points (observed max == C, non-zero all-C overlap)

diagnosis: A one-shot batch of C simultaneous requests did not reproduce the measured closed-loop scheduler states: the measured workload continuously admits new requests while others decode, so prompt chunks share the 16,384-token budget at different offsets. At C=16 the simultaneous batch packed 8 whole 2048-token prompts per step (no split), so the Stage3C kernels never ran during conditioning.
remedy: Full point-matched shadow-workload conditioning (256 unmeasured closed-loop requests per point), committed before the rerun.
